warnings: Sample for explicit relationship definition fallback. It is intended for domains that contain Concept, Relationship, and a stricter Subject_Verb relationship definition.
Expected result in such a domain: two concepts are created; the Subject_Verb relationship may fail endpoint compatibility and retry as Relationship unless strictDefinition is true.

If Subject_Verb is not present in the active domain, the relationship is skipped as a missing definition because fallback only applies after the requested definition exists and rejects compatible-looking endpoints.
